_about: One name per thing in the app (server/js/i18n.js). Each group lists keys that name the same thing on different surfaces (menu, rail, Deck, Store, first run): in every language they must read the same. server/test/i18n-glossary.test.mjs checks it. A key that names a different thing with the same English word (the weather's 'Now', Home Assistant's dashboards) does not belong here.

capture.what: Capture: the page and the Deck category

dashboard.what: The dashboard, as a choice of what a screen shows and as a page

widgets-only.what: The 'widgets only' way of using Xenon

edit-widgets-on-screen.what: The action that edits the widgets over the desktop: one key for the menu and the Deck

settings-word.what: The word for settings on buttons and titles

phone.what: The phone, as a page and as a Deck category

background.what: Backgrounds, as a page and as a Store kind

create-and-share.what: The page for making, importing and sharing widgets
